jcr:description: Some bunion procedures can shorten and alter the look of the first ray, that may cause pain and metatarsalgia. LapiFuse is different. Traditional fusion surgeries simply correct bunion deformities at only the big toe joint. By using “Triplanar Correction,” LapiFuse can correct foot deformities caused by bunions at the source of the problem leading to holistic treatment that can reduce pain, all while preserving the natural look of the foot.

text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text_652839079.text:
Some bunion procedures can shorten and alter the look of the first ray, that may cause pain and metatarsalgia. Traditional fusion surgeries simply correct bunion deformities at only the big toe joint. By using “Triplanar Correction,” LapiFuse can correct foot deformities caused by bunions at the source of the problem leading to holistic treatment that can reduce pain, all while preserving the natural look of the foot.

 

Key features

  • Designed to increase fusion and lower recurrence rates1
  • Preserves length of the first ray2
  • Predictable and reproducible triplanar correction
